items.source: A variation on start() that allows specifying a timeout value to use for asynchronous processing. If complete() is not called within the specified value, the request times out.
items.translation: 这是 `start()` 的一种变体，允许指定用于异步处理的超时值。如果未在该指定时间内调用 complete()，则请求将超时。

items.source: Enable asynchronous processing after which the response remains open until a call to complete() is made or the server times out the request.
items.translation: 启用异步处理，在此模式下响应将保持打开状态，直到调用complete()或服务器请求超时。

items.source: A variation on start() that allows specifying a timeout value to use for asynchronous processing.
items.translation: 一种 `start()` 的变体，允许指定用于异步处理的超时值。

items.source: Enable asynchronous processing after which the response remains open until a call to complete() is made or the server times out the request. Once enabled, additional calls to this method are ignored.
items.translation: 启用异步处理，在此模式下响应将保持打开状态，直到调用complete()或服务器超时。一旦启用，对此方法的额外调用将被忽略。

items.source: Mark asynchronous request processing as completed.
items.translation: 标记异步请求处理为已完成。

items.source: Return whether asynchronous request processing has been completed.
items.translation: 返回异步请求处理是否已完成。

items.source: Return whether asynchronous request processing has been started.
items.translation: 返回异步请求处理是否已启动。

items.source:
A control that can put the processing of an HTTP request in asynchronous mode during
which the response remains open until explicitly closed.
items.translation: 一个控件，可将 HTTP 请求的处理置于异步模式，在此期间响应保持打开状态，直到显式关闭。
